DECLARE @targetPoint GEOGRAPHY = geography::Point(#{lat}, #{lng}, 4326);
SELECT b.branch_id AS branchId, b.branch_name AS branchName, b.location.STDistance(@targetPoint) AS distanceMeters, ROUND(AVG(p.revenue_growth), 2) AS revenueGrowth FROM branches_51 b LEFT JOIN branch_performance_51 p ON b.branch_id = p.branch_id WHERE b.location.STDistance(@targetPoint) <= #{radiusMeters} GROUP BY b.branch_id, b.branch_name, b.location.STDistance(@targetPoint) ORDER BY distanceMeters ASC
